what_it_is: Aspiration catheter featuring coil, braid, and end-to-end nitinol construction for navigating vasculature during acute ischemic stroke procedures. Available in React 68 and React 71 sizes.
indications: Aspiration thrombectomy during acute ischemic stroke (AIS) procedures.
use_notes: Coil, braid, and nitinol construction provides navigability and support.
